correctness.rationale: For every vertex its isolation indicator depends only on adjacent deleted edges. Disjoint edge sets give zero covariance; adjacent vertices share exactly one edge, yielding the exact degree formula (1). Algebra gives the star/double-star formulas. The strictly decreasing integer sequence k/2^k and AM-GM establish a strict all-n>=11 improvement. The leaf-extension enumerator is mathematically exhaustive up to order eleven and AHU center codes distinguish isomorphism classes. Exact rational minimization at all 235 eleven-vertex classes proves uniqueness; independent Prüfer and edge-state enumeration checks bolster the finite certificate. The unbounded statement is not extrapolated from finite checks.

value.rationale: Isolated vertices after independent edge failures are singleton surviving components, a direct fragmentation and resilience observable. The theorem gives a natural exact first size at which the canonical star ceases to minimize their fluctuations, proves the unique optimizer at that boundary, and provides a strict systematic counterfamily at every larger order. It is not merely a narrow arbitrary graph calculation or a routine restatement of the indicator formula; the required all-tree comparison and sharp first cutoff are the substantive contribution.
